thread:
maria: Quick sync - we want to run a rollback simulation before we flip a small canary for price_v5. Goal: surface vendor exclusions and AR hits so the canary has minimal manual work.

kevin: I can run a rollback sim in staging. What do you need from me?

maria: Final price CSV (sample rows), the vendor carve-out list from legal, and the retro-cutoff parameter (default 45 days). Canary plan: 3% traffic for 3 days.

tara: For A/B: A = v4 baseline, B = v5 tiered. Exclude reserved capacity, delayed-ingest accounts, and any contracts legal flags. I'll produce cohort SQL + opt-in list.

juan: Legal note: VC-202 and VC-305 contain language that prevents unilateral retro credits beyond 45 days for certain enterprise accounts. I'll publish a list of contract IDs to auto-exclude unless we obtain written consent.

leo: AR rules for the sim: flag any simulated account where abs(delta) > $1k or pct_delta > 25%. If total simulated retro liability > $3k, we treat as a blocker for canary. Need CSV export of flagged rows for ticketing.

kevin: I'll run the sim and emit a small review CSV. Sample command I'll use: `./scripts/simulate_rollbacks --input price_v5_sample.csv --cutoff 45 --output sim-report.json`. For flagged rows I will set `manual_review=true`. Example CSV snippet:

account_id,old_amount,new_amount,delta,pct_delta,manual_review
ACCT-901,1200,900,-300,-25, true
ACCT-242,5000,5100,100,2,false

billing-bot: preflight checklist: sim-run, csv-schema, vendor-carveouts, ar-export. All items must pass in staging namespace before we start canary.

maria: Timeline: sim by Thu, review Fri, canary Mon. Action items: Kevin - sim run + sample CSV & PR; Tara - cohort & excludes; Juan - vendor IDs + consent process; Leo - AR sheet + webhook. Post PR links and sim-report here. :thumbsup:

juan: I'll post vendor IDs today and draft the consent email template for sales/legal coordination.

kevin: Opening PR with schema + sim harness now. Will ping when results are in.

maria: Thanks all. If the sim shows >10 manual-review heavy accounts we'll consider increasing the canary duration or doing a targeted pilot. Keep updates here.
